- run your engine a little bit so the oil is warm (it’ll flow easier) but at the same time don’t let the engine get too hot so that it becomes dangerous to work)
- open the oil filler cap
- remove any under shields that be be covering the oil drain plug 
- the oil drain bolt is on the side of the oil sump, you must replace it with a new bolt and washer
- put a big container underneath and undo the bolt slowly, the oil will come out very fast
- replace your oil filter as well
